text:
Sam Carter: Heads up — Nimbus Corp wants to kick off a 2-week POC next Mon. They list SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and strict domain allowlist as blockers. Can someone own the auth side?
Devon Li: I can take the lead on technical POC. Do we have their IdP metadata yet?
Sam Carter: Not yet. They said their IdP is Okta and will share metadata by EOD tomorrow. They also asked about IdP-initiated vs SP-initiated flows.
Devon Li: We support both. For Okta we usually recommend SP-initiated for initial tests, IdP-initiated for user convenience. I'll draft the steps.
Hannah Kim: Security question — Nimbus requires SCIM delta sync + group membership to be reflected within 120s for access changes. Is that achievable?
Mike Ortega: 120s is tight but doable with push-style provisioning. Our SCIM endpoint supports incremental syncs and push events. We'll need to discuss rate limits for large orgs.
Devon Li: For the POC we can enable real-time provisioning (non-batched) and set throttles to their expected user churn. I'll add a note on token rotation and scoped SCIM creds.
Sam Carter: Pricing: they asked if SCIM is an add-on or included in Enterprise SKU for Dedicated. Any quick answer for the call?
Eve Legal: We usually include SCIM in Enterprise plans; dedicated customers get SCIM and RBAC features. Pricing specifics are handled by sales ops but tell them it's included subject to contract.
Devon Li: Also call out audit logs — they want per-user provisioning audit trail for compliance. We keep full SCIM request logs for 90 days by default; can extend.
Hannah Kim: Need to confirm encryption-at-rest for SCIM tokens and that KMS integration is available. Also they'll want an IP/domain allowlist and enforced SAML certificate rotation policy.
Mike Ortega: KMS/HSM integration is on Private and Dedicated. For hosted we have encrypted secrets and a managed KMS; can support customer KMS on Private. Domain allowlist: we can restrict inbound requests to delegated IPs + SAML audience/ACS checks.
Devon Li: I'll prepare a short checklist for next week's demo: 1) SP metadata + ACS URL, 2) SCIM base URL and token, 3) sample group mapping (e.g., SCIM group -> Redwood role), 4) RBAC role matrix, 5) audit/log requirements, 6) allowed IP ranges.
Sam Carter: Perfect. Can you also include a sample SCIM mapping payload we can send them?
Devon Li: Yep — sample snippet below.
Devon Li: ```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "add",
      "path": "members",
      "value": [ { "value": "user-123", "display": "jane.d@Nimbus.com" } ]
    }
  ]
}
```
Hannah Kim: Also include the security questionnaire items: SAML metadata fields we require, SCIM token rotation cadence (recommend 90 days), and RBAC auditability (who can assign roles).
Sam Carter: I'll coordinate with Nimbus on timelines. Devon — can you post the checklist + docs link to the channel by EOD? If not, flag blockers.
Devon Li: On it. I'll post a runbook and a minimal demo script.
infra-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging-redwood-auth v2.3.1 at 2026-03-28T02:00Z (no downtime expected).
Mike Ortega: Heads up — that deploy contains SCIM performance fixes that should help their 120s requirement.
Sam Carter: Great, thanks all. I'll loop Nimbus and ask for metadata.
Eve Legal: I'll prep the standard SCIM/SSO addendum for the contract.
Devon Li: If anyone has recent examples of Okta config screenshots, drop them in the thread. Makes the demo smoother.
Sam Carter: Thanks — I'll circle back once I have the metadata. :thumbsup:
